title: Privacy Policy
description: How My Trip World collects and uses the details you share when you send a travel enquiry.

children.text: What we collect
When you send an enquiry we receive the details you choose to share: your name, phone number, email address and travel preferences.
How we use it
We use these details only to respond to your enquiry, prepare quotes and manage bookings you make with us. We do not sell your information.
Sharing
To complete a booking we share the necessary traveller details with airlines, hotels, cruise lines, visa authorities and local partners.
Your choices
You may ask us to correct or delete your details at any time by contacting us.

title: Terms & Conditions
description: Terms for prices, bookings, payments and cancellations on My Trip World tour packages.

children.text: Prices and offers
Prices shown are indicative offer prices and are subject to availability, travel dates, currency movements and supplier changes. Your final price is confirmed in writing with your quote.
Bookings and payments
A booking is confirmed once the agreed advance is received and acknowledged by My Trip World. Balance payment schedules are shared at the time of booking.
Cancellations
Cancellation and refund terms depend on the airline, hotel and cruise partners involved and are shared with every quote.
Travel documents
Travellers are responsible for holding valid passports and meeting visa requirements. Our team assists with the process.

name: Delhi NCR
area: Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Faridabad and Ghaziabad
intro: Delhi NCR is home ground for My Trip World. Our head office is in Gurugram, a short drive from Indira Gandhi International Airport, so travellers from Delhi, Noida, Faridabad and Ghaziabad can plan a trip in person or over a call.

International flights from Delhi leave from Terminal 3, which has regular services to Singapore, Bangkok and Kuala Lumpur — the usual gateways for our South-East Asia packages — as well as onward connections to Australia and New Zealand.
notes: Non-stop flying time is about 5 hours 45 minutes to Singapore and about 4 hours 15 minutes to Bangkok.
You can meet our team at the Gurugram office before you book.
Winter fog can affect early-morning departures from Delhi between December and January, so it is worth allowing extra time.
officeAnswer: Yes. Our head office is at Office No. 101, 1st Floor, Dhanwapur Road, near Sector 4/5 Chowk, Gurugram, Haryana 122001 — within Delhi NCR.

name: Mumbai
intro: Mumbai is one of India's busiest international gateways, and a natural starting point for South-East Asia, Australia and cruise holidays. International flights use Terminal 2 of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport.
Travellers from Mumbai, Navi Mumbai and Thane book with My Trip World by phone, WhatsApp and email. We arrange flights from Mumbai, hotels, sightseeing and transfers as a single package.
notes: Non-stop flying time is about 5 hours 30 minutes to Singapore and about 4 hours 30 minutes to Bangkok.
Mumbai is also a convenient departure point for fly-cruise holidays.
The monsoon months of June to September can mean longer drives to the airport, so allow extra time for your pick-up.
officeAnswer: No. Our offices are in Gurugram and Narwana, Haryana. Travellers from Mumbai plan and book with us by phone, WhatsApp and email, and receive all tickets and vouchers digitally.

name: Bengaluru
intro: From Bengaluru, South-East Asia is closer than most travellers expect. Kempegowda International Airport at Devanahalli has services to Singapore, Bangkok and Kuala Lumpur, which makes our three-country and five-country circuits an easy fit.
The airport sits well north of the city, so a planned pick-up matters here more than in most metros. My Trip World builds the transfer into your package.
notes: Non-stop flying time is about 4 hours 30 minutes to Singapore and about 3 hours 45 minutes to Bangkok.
Kempegowda International Airport is roughly 35 km from central Bengaluru — allow for traffic on the way.
Corporate groups from Bengaluru can ask for a tailor-made offsite or incentive trip.
officeAnswer: No. Our offices are in Gurugram and Narwana, Haryana. Travellers from Bengaluru plan and book with us by phone, WhatsApp and email, and receive all tickets and vouchers digitally.

airport: Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport
intro: Kolkata is the closest Indian metro to South-East Asia. From Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport at Dum Dum, Bangkok is a short flight away, which keeps travel days short on Thailand, Vietnam and Cambodia itineraries.
Travellers from Kolkata and the rest of eastern India book with My Trip World remotely — by phone, WhatsApp and email — and travel on the same packages and offer prices shown on this site.
notes: Non-stop flying time is about 2 hours 30 minutes to Bangkok and about 4 hours 15 minutes to Singapore.
A shorter flight means more usable time at the destination on a week-long trip.
Durga Puja and winter holidays are busy travel periods from Kolkata — early booking helps with seats.
officeAnswer: No. Our offices are in Gurugram and Narwana, Haryana. Travellers from Kolkata plan and book with us by phone, WhatsApp and email, and receive all tickets and vouchers digitally.

question: What is included in a My Trip World tour package?
answer: Our international packages bundle international flights, hotel stay with daily breakfast, airport pick-up and drop transfers, and guided sightseeing in one offer price. The Australia & New Zealand package includes all meals and cruising. Exact inclusions are listed on each package page and confirmed in your quote.

question: Is airport pick-up and drop really free?
answer: Yes. My Trip World provides complimentary home-city to airport pick-up and drop with its packages, so your holiday starts from your own city rather than from the airport.

question: Which international tour packages do you offer from India?
answer: Our best-selling packages are One Trip, Five Countries (Singapore, Cambodia, Vietnam, Malaysia and Thailand, 13 nights / 14 days, offer price ₹99,999), One Trip, Three Countries (Singapore, Malaysia and Phuket, 7 nights / 8 days, offer price ₹89,999) and Australia & New Zealand (11 nights / 12 days, offer price ₹3,49,999). We also plan Vietnam holidays and Norwegian Cruise Line sailings.

question: Do you run group tours, or only private trips?
answer: Both. My Trip World plans group tours, individual tours for couples and families, and corporate tours for companies.

question: Do you arrange India tours for travellers from other countries?
answer: Yes. As well as taking travellers from India abroad, we welcome guests from other countries to India. India tours are tailor-made — tell us your dates and interests and our team will plan the trip.

question: Which cities in India can I travel from?
answer: Anywhere in India. Our offices are in Gurugram and Narwana, Haryana, and we plan trips for travellers from every city — from the major metros such as Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Kolkata, Chennai and Hyderabad to smaller cities across the country. Bookings outside Haryana are handled by phone, WhatsApp and email.

question: How do I book, and how do I get a price?
answer: Send an enquiry from this website, message us on WhatsApp or call +91 97280-24440. Share your destination, travel month and number of travellers, and our team replies with an itinerary and a clear price.

question: Do you help with visas?
answer: Visa rules depend on the destination and your passport. Share your travel plan when you enquire and our team will tell you what is needed for your trip.

question: How long has My Trip World been in business?
answer: My Trip World has completed more than 12 years in the tourism industry. It is a division of S.C.R Infotech Pvt. Ltd., with offices in Gurugram and Narwana, Haryana.

Chennai and Bengaluru are the usual connecting airports for other routes.
officeAnswer: No. Our offices are in Gurugram and Narwana, Haryana. Travellers from Coimbatore plan and book with us by phone, WhatsApp and email, and receive all tickets and vouchers digitally.

name: Thiruvananthapuram
intro: Thiruvananthapuram International Airport sits at the southern tip of India, only a few kilometres from the city centre, and has services to Singapore and Kuala Lumpur. For southern Kerala and neighbouring Kanyakumari district it is the closest starting point for a South-East Asia tour.
Travellers here book with us by phone, WhatsApp and email, and we arrange flights from Thiruvananthapuram with stays, transfers and sightseeing in one package.
notes: Non-stop flying time to Singapore is about 4 hours 15 minutes.
The airport is unusually close to the city, so the drive is short.
Where dates do not match direct flights, Kochi or Chennai are the usual alternatives.
officeAnswer: No. Our offices are in Gurugram and Narwana, Haryana. Travellers from Thiruvananthapuram plan and book with us by phone, WhatsApp and email, and receive all tickets and vouchers digitally.

name: Goa
airport: Manohar International Airport (Mopa) and Goa International Airport (Dabolim)
intro: Goa has two airports: Manohar International Airport at Mopa in the north (code GOX) and Goa International Airport at Dabolim near Vasco (code GOI). Which one suits you depends on where in Goa you live and which airline we book.
International choices from Goa are limited, so most tours connect through Mumbai, Bengaluru or Delhi. We check both Goa airports when building your flights.
notes: Mopa (GOX) is closer for North Goa; Dabolim (GOI) is closer for South Goa and Panaji.
Most international itineraries from Goa include one connection.
The monsoon months of June to September bring heavy rain — allow extra time for the drive.
officeAnswer: No. Our offices are in Gurugram and Narwana, Haryana. Travellers from Goa plan and book with us by phone, WhatsApp and email, and receive all tickets and vouchers digitally.

name: Narwana & Jind
area: Narwana, Jind, Kaithal, Tohana and nearby Haryana
intro: Narwana is where My Trip World began, and our office is still here — at Gali No. 05, Pritam Bagh, opposite the bus stand in Hanuman Nagar. Travellers from Narwana, Jind, Kaithal and Tohana can walk in, sit with our team and plan their trip in person.

There is no international airport in the district, so trips start from Indira Gandhi International Airport in Delhi. This is exactly why our packages include complimentary home-city to airport pick-up and drop: the journey to Delhi is part of the plan, not something you arrange yourself.
notes: Delhi's international airport is roughly 180 km from Narwana by road.
Meet our team at the Narwana office, near DAV School.
Group departures suit families and friends travelling together from the same town.
officeAnswer: Yes. Our Narwana office is at Gali No. 05, Pritam Bagh, Opp. Bus Stand, Hanuman Nagar, Near DAV School, Narwana, Haryana 126116.

name: Hisar
intro: Travellers from Hisar, Hansi, Fatehabad and Sirsa start their international trips from Indira Gandhi International Airport in Delhi. Hisar's own airport, Maharaja Agrasen International Airport, handles a limited number of domestic flights and does not yet offer the international routes our packages use.
Our Narwana office is the nearest to Hisar, and many travellers from the area book with us there or over a call. The drive to Delhi is arranged as part of your package.
notes: Delhi's international airport is roughly 170 km from Hisar by road.
Our Narwana office is roughly 70 km from Hisar.
Winter fog on Haryana's highways can slow early-morning drives — we plan pick-up times with a margin.
officeAnswer: Not in Hisar itself. The nearest My Trip World office is in Narwana, with a second office in Gurugram.

name: Rohtak
intro: Rohtak is one of the closest Haryana cities to Delhi's international airport, which keeps the start of an international trip simple. Travellers from Rohtak, Jhajjar, Bahadurgarh and Sonipat fly from Indira Gandhi International Airport, Terminal 3.
Our Gurugram office is a comfortable drive from Rohtak, so you can plan in person if you prefer, or book entirely by phone and WhatsApp.
notes: Delhi's international airport is roughly 75 km from Rohtak by road.
Our Gurugram office is the nearest to Rohtak.
A short drive to the airport makes early-morning international departures practical.
officeAnswer: Not in Rohtak itself. The nearest My Trip World office is in Gurugram, with a second office in Narwana.

name: Karnal & Panipat
intro: Karnal and Panipat sit on the Delhi–Chandigarh highway, so travellers here have Delhi's international airport within a few hours by road. Almost all of our tours for this part of Haryana start from Indira Gandhi International Airport.
Both of our offices are in Haryana, and travellers from Karnal, Panipat, Kurukshetra and Yamunanagar book with our team by phone, WhatsApp or in person.
notes: Delhi's international airport is roughly 135 km from Karnal and 105 km from Panipat by road.

Group tours are popular with families and business groups from the region.
